decisions.evidence: Overall, the low TPSA of 16.91, estimated logP of 3.4131, strongest basic pKa of 9.0411, tertiary mixed amine (1), two aromatic carbocycles, benzene count of 2, and rotatable-bond count of 10 together make the molecule look hERG-prone, despite the moderate molecular weight of 367.557 and the absence of an acidic site.
Overall, the balance of analog evidence supports option (B): blocks hERG.
